description: An agent-based, networked social simulation of mask-wearing adoption under social influence, policy mandates, enforcement, retail supply/price dynamics, household coordination, and media campaigns/misinformation. Agents are embedded in a small-world social network and interact with locations, retailers, policymakers, and media channels on a daily time step.

modules.name: SocialInfluenceModule
modules.description: Updates individual beliefs and perceived norms from social neighbors' observed behavior and stated attitudes.

update_rule.pseudocode:
for each person p:
  Np = sample_fraction(neighbors(p), neighbor_sampling_fraction)
  avg_neighbor_belief = mean(belief_pro_mask[q] for q in Np)
  avg_neighbor_behavior = mean(mask_wearing_today[q] for q in Np)
  norm_signal = avg_neighbor_behavior
  w = social_influence_weight * p.conformity_trait
  noise = Normal(0, belief_update_noise_std)
  p.perceived_norm = (1 - norm_sensitivity)*p.perceived_norm + norm_sensitivity*norm_signal
  p.belief_pro_mask = clip( (1 - w)*p.belief_pro_mask + w*avg_neighbor_belief + noise, 0, 1 )
notes: Uses partial neighbor sampling to reduce computation.
Observed behavior contributes to perceived_norm; beliefs drive attitudinal convergence.

modules.name: MediaExposureModule
modules.description: Simulates exposure to campaigns and misinformation; updates beliefs, perceived risk, and trust based on message credibility and reach.

notes: Campaign reach and misinfo reach are applied via channel setup.
Exposure frequencies are controlled by per-week frequencies mapped to daily schedules.

modules.name: PolicyBroadcastModule
modules.description: Applies policy mandates and enforcement parameters to locations during the policy window.

update_rule.pseudocode:
if policy_start_day <= day_index <= policy_end_day:
  PolicyMaker.current_policy = 'mandate'
  for each location L:
    req = false
    if L.type == 'Workplace' and mandate_required_Workplace: req = true
    if L.type == 'Transit'   and mandate_required_Transit:   req = true
    if L.type == 'Store'     and mandate_required_Store:     req = true
    L.mask_policy_required = req
    base = enforcement_level
    L.enforcement_strictness = base
else:
  PolicyMaker.current_policy = 'none'
  for each location L:
    L.mask_policy_required = false
    L.enforcement_strictness = 0.0
notes: Fine amount is consumed by enforcement logic in MobilityAndEnforcementModule.
Enforcement strictness is scaled globally; location-specific overrides can be added.

modules.name: DecisionComplianceModule
modules.description: Computes daily mask-wearing decision from beliefs, norms, risk, trust, policy pressure, costs, and budget/inventory constraints.

notes: Policy pressure stands in for expected enforcement; specific enforcement consequences happen at locations.
Budget/inventory gating triggers purchase intent when necessary.

modules.name: MarketPurchaseModule
modules.description: Routes purchase intents to retailers respecting inventory, max daily sales, and affordability; updates budgets and inventories.

update_rule.pseudocode:
reset Retailer.daily_sales = 0
for each purchase_intent (pid, qty):
  choose retailer r with max inventory (break ties randomly)
  purch_qty = min(qty, r.inventory, r.max_daily_sales - r.daily_sales)
  spend = purch_qty * r.price_per_mask
  if purch_qty > 0 and Person[pid].budget >= spend:
    r.inventory -= purch_qty
    r.daily_sales += purch_qty
    Person[pid].budget -= spend
    Person[pid].has_masks_inventory += purch_qty
    append purchase_log(pid, r.id, purch_qty, r.price_per_mask)
notes: Simple greedy routing; can be extended to spatial or price-sensitive choice.

modules.name: RetailerRestockPricingModule
modules.description: Restocks retailer inventories and adjusts prices in response to scarcity.

update_rule.pseudocode:
for each retailer r:
  target_add = round(retailer_restock_rate_daily * initial_mask_inventory_per_retailer)
  r.inventory += target_add
  scarcity = clamp(1 - r.inventory / (initial_mask_inventory_per_retailer + 1e-6), 0, 1)
  price_multiplier = 1 + retailer_price_markup_scarcity_sensitivity * scarcity
  r.price_per_mask = max(0.5, mask_cost_base * price_multiplier)
notes: Price responds to inventory scarcity with capped floor.

modules.name: MobilityAndEnforcementModule
modules.description: Simulates daily visits to locations; enforces mask policies, records denied entries and fines.

notes: Mobility schedules can be precomputed by role/age.
Contact rates are used to weight visit counts but are not epidemiological here.

modules.name: HouseholdNormsModule
modules.description: Reinforces household-level norms and coordinates mask purchases when collective inventory is low.

update_rule.pseudocode:
for each household h:
  avg_belief = mean(Person[m].belief_pro_mask for m in h.members)
  h.shared_norm_pro_mask = (1 - household_influence_weight)*h.shared_norm_pro_mask + household_influence_weight*avg_belief
  total_inventory = sum(Person[m].has_masks_inventory for m in h.members)
  if total_inventory < household_purchase_coordination_threshold:
    select buyer = argmax(Person[m].budget)
    emit purchase_intent(buyer, household_purchase_coordination_threshold - total_inventory)
notes: Household norms feed back via SocialInfluenceModule indirectly through perceived_norm.

modules.name: AdoptionAggregator
modules.description: Aggregates daily adoption rates and computes time-based metrics.

update_rule.pseudocode:
adoption = mean(Person.mask_wearing_today)
record(observable.adoption_rate_daily, adoption)
by_age = group_mean(Person.mask_wearing_today by Person.age_group)
record(observable.adoption_rate_by_age_daily, by_age)
update peak_adoption_rate = max(peak_adoption_rate, adoption)
if first day adoption >= target_adoption_threshold_70 and time_to_70 not set: set time_to_70 = current_day
if adoption >= target_adoption_threshold_80: sustained_counter += 1
notes: Stores cumulative metrics for reporting at the end.

modules.name: ExposureAndEnforcementAggregator
modules.description: Aggregates exposures to misinformation/campaigns, enforcement actions, and purchases.

update_rule.pseudocode:
misinfo_today = sum(delta(Person.exposure_to_misinformation))  # per-day increments
camp_today = sum(delta(Person.exposure_to_campaigns))
record(observable.misinformation_exposure_rate_daily, misinfo_today / population_size)
record(observable.enforcement_actions_daily, len(enforcement_actions_log))
purchased_today = sum(qty in purchase_log)
record(observable.masks_purchased_daily, purchased_today)
cum_enforcement += len(enforcement_actions_log)
cum_purchases += purchased_today
metric.enforcement_actions_count = cum_enforcement
metric.average_masks_purchased_per_person = cum_purchases / population_size
metric.misinformation_exposure_rate = moving_average(observable.misinformation_exposure_rate_daily, smoothing_window_days)
notes: delta() is per-day difference of cumulative per-person counters.
moving_average window configurable for rate smoothing.

algorithms.small_world_network: Watts-Strogatz graph generation with N=population_size, k=avg_social_degree, p=ws_rewiring_prob.
algorithms.belief_update: Convex combination of own belief and neighbor belief with noise; perceived norms from observed neighbor behaviors.
algorithms.media_broadcast: Stochastic exposure per channel per day based on reach and weekly frequency mapping to daily schedule.
algorithms.mask_decision: Logit (sigmoid) of utility from beliefs, risk, norms, trust, policy minus perceived cost; temperature controls stochasticity.
algorithms.purchase_routing: Greedy assignment to retailer with highest available inventory subject to sales caps and affordability.
algorithms.restock_pricing: Add inventory proportional to initial capacity; price multiplier increases with scarcity.
algorithms.mobility_and_enforcement: Daily visits drawn from schedules; when mask required and not worn, probabilistic check leads to denial or fine.
algorithms.metrics_computation: Streaming aggregation for peak, thresholds, Gini across age groups, period differences, and rates.
